summary: Romblon representative with 115 principal-authored bills. Authored an anti-dynasty ban and a waste treatment regulation; co-authored a bill postponing barangay and SK elections, the national minimum wage, estate tax amnesty and travel-tax abolition.
caveat: Economic items are a labor-and-tax mix of co-authored bills and net near zero, so economics is unscored.
